Overview

Changwon is a city in GSN with a population of 1,060,000. A planned industrial city on the southern coast, known for its machinery industry and beautiful seaside parks. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
